A.naveen, ...PETITIONER  AND Government Of Andhra Pradesh and Others ...RESPONDENT(S)

Counsel for the Petitioner:
1. C SRINIVASA BABA Counsel for the Respondent(S):
1. GP FOR SERVICES IV

The Court made the following interim order:
The petitioner, a qualified Anesthesia Technician has been discharging his duties in pursuance of agreement dated 12.10.2023 with the 2nd respondent.
Without any notice, the 2nd respondent is not allowing the petitioner to discharge his functions.
Hence the writ petition is filed.
Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the recruitment of the petitioner to the post was done by the District Selection Committee.

Later, the petitioner was appointed as Anesthesia Technician on 11.10.2022 and he was allotted to Government General Hospital, Machilipatnam, Krishna District on contract basis for one year and later, it was renewed for one more year.
The petitioner was implicated in a case in Crime No.140 of 2024 for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2) and 420 IPC.
The petitioner was granted bail on 06.05.2024.
When the petitioner attended to discharge his duties, the 2nd respondent orally did not allow the petitioner.

sentences.text: The writ petition was listed on 12.08.2024 and adjourned to today at the request of learned Government Pleader for Services to get instructions.
When the matter is listed today, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Services would submit that no instructions are received from the authorities.
As seen from the material, the agreement between the petitioner and the 2nd respondent is subsisting as on today.
The authority has to issue show- cause notice and follow due procedure if the authority inclines to initiate action against the petitioner regarding Crime No.140 of 2024 of Avanigadda Police Station.
Without there being any proceedings from the 2nd respondent, the 2nd respondent shall not restrict the petitioner from discharging his duties.

In the facts and circumstances of the case, the 2nd respondent shall permit the petitioner to discharge his duties as Anesthesia Technician as per the terms and conditions of the agreement dated 12.10.2020 (Ex.P.2).
This order will not preclude the authority to initiate any proceedings against the petitioner in accordance with law.
List the matter on 11.09.2024.
